rollout: disabled until both the backend advertises honor and the APK has a nonempty public HONOR app ID

behavior.registration: existing authenticated permission-checked device API, one provider per installation
behavior.legacy: missing provider means Expo; unsupported devices and old servers keep the Expo path
behavior.sdkInitialization: only on deliberate or previously enabled registration, never at application creation
behavior.click: phase one opens the APP home; business detail deep-linking through the HONOR notification is not implemented
behavior.receipt: provider acceptance only; authenticated HONOR delivery callback is not implemented
behavior.diagnostics: existing Expo/FCM callback and channel counters do not validate the HONOR route; no callback record is not proof of HONOR non-delivery
behavior.routing: no automatic parallel HONOR/FCM fanout or fallback after ambiguous send
behavior.classification: no assumed service-message entitlement; vendor classification/quota must be confirmed before production

beforeRealDeviceAcceptance: Create/verify the HONOR developer app for the existing package and release signing SHA256; user must complete verification and accept platform agreements
Enable PUSH and securely provide app ID, client ID and client secret, without posting secrets to chat
Update third-party SDK/privacy disclosure and confirm consent-gated initialization
Review/merge the existing APP worktree and current dev without losing prior UI and diagnostics work
Confirm the migration target, run the existing migration command for provider columns, then deploy the disabled provider
Rebuild and install the correctly signed APK; no existing APK is changed by this source work
Opt in one authorized account for no-VPN cellular, background and lock-screen acceptance; a provider success is not handset delivery
Verify logout, recorded-meal skip, quiet hours, token rotation and old-client regression before broad rollout
rollback: Disable HONOR registrations first. Do not roll back to Expo-only backend while active HONOR device bindings remain; rebind through the existing APP or retain the provider-aware backend. Never relabel an HONOR token as Expo.
